options.label: Base Z-Image
options.note: Base Z-Image Turbo. The one to beat.

options.label: Stable Yogi
options.note: Stable Yogi 2603: almost the same picture as base, in half the time.

options.label: MS V3
options.note: MS Z-Image Turbo V3: a deeper sky, and skin that swings between textured and waxy from seed to seed.

options.label: Fascium
options.note: Fascium "Being Boring": the smoothest, waxiest skin of the four.

options.label: Shift 2
options.note: Shift 2: the pores come back at the same speed. This is the one to change.

options.label: Shift 1
options.note: Shift 1: the most texture, with fine lines under the eye. It starts to look dry.

options.label: 16 steps
options.note: 16 steps: more freckles and some film grain, at twice the time.
